item.title: It’s a green screen. Not a green room.
item.description: For the most part, people who call the studio wanting to rent one of our stages for the green screen know what they want. They’ve been in the business for even a short period of time and can at least sound like they know what they’re talking about. But every once in a while someone will call and blatantly show how new they are to the industry.
